Portfolio — MA Creative Documentary Filmmaking, Edinburgh Napier University

Vittoria Moretti

Human rights advocate and documentary storyteller, based in Nairobi, Kenya, working across film and photography.

LinkedIn

I am a human rights and advocacy professional who believes that storytelling can be a powerful tool for environmental and socio-economic justice.

This portfolio brings together documentary and photography work produced during my human rights fieldwork, alongside recent film and photography training, in support of my application to the MA Creative Documentary Filmmaking at Edinburgh Napier University. Field-produced pieces are presented here with attribution to the organisations for which they were made; original publication links are included throughout.

Field-produced work

Documentary film made during my work in human rights and environmental advocacy.

The Great Green Rush

Democratic Republic of Congo · RFUK

Role: coordination, assistant director

A short documentary examining land grabbing and human rights violations linked to the development of carbon markets in the DRC. Made during my time as Campaigns Officer at RFUK (Rainforest Foundation UK), working alongside investigative journalist Franck Zongwe.

Watch on YouTubeThe Great Green Rush ↗

Muanda: A Bleeding Land

Muanda, DRC · RFUK & CORAP

Role: main cinematographer (field), producer

A short documentary on the consequences of oil extraction by Perenco for local communities in Muanda, western DRC, produced in the context of the Permanent Peoples' Tribunal session on the DRC. Filmed solo during a field trip, then produced as RFUK Campaigns Officer in partnership with Congolese NGO CORAP.

Watch on YouTubeMuanda: A Bleeding Land ↗

Fa Mbi Lege

Kinshasa, DRC · ASHR

Role: producer

An awareness and fundraising video for ASHR (Artivism and Sport for Human Rights), the Italian-registered charity I co-founded and serve as Vice President, supporting people living with disabilities at the Kitambo Centre in Kinshasa.

Watch on YouTubeFa Mbi Lege ↗

Gender-Based Violence Survivors Learn to Rebuild Engines as They Rebuild Lives

Kasai Central, DRC · UNHCR

Role: assistant to cinematographer — interviews, script, photography

A published feature on a UNHCR vocational training programme supporting survivors of gender-based violence in DRC's Kasai Central province to learn auto-mechanics, electronics and IT skills as part of their recovery and self-reliance. Produced during my time with UNHCR DRC, working alongside the lead cinematographer on interviews, script and photography.

Read on UNHCR.orgunhcr.org/news/stories ↗
